title: I Engineered a 1-Hour Workday (Corporate 9-5)
description:
I don’t have a magic morning routine or a color-coded Notion productivity dashboard. What I do have is a system that cut my 9–5 down to 1 hour a day. It's all about workflow optimization baybe(Included that one just for the keyword juice). 

If you’re working from home, stuck in endless Zoom calls, or just tired of wasting time pretending to be productive — this is how you actually optimize your job.

 Uploaded again from former Yugoslavia. 

P.S. I am working on a SKOOL community, that is why I am in this boring city(Skopje). Nothing to do here but write. 
 If you have any suggestions, things you would want me to include I'm all ears.
